verdict.rationale: Gemini's docs describe Scheduled Actions for making Gemini part of daily, weekly and monthly routines, with examples such as a recurring daily news digest. The Daily Brief is a further automatically delivered personalized digest. The core of the story is covered by first-party docs, but only the recurring case is shown. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of one-off scheduled tasks, details on how results are delivered (notifications or where outputs appear), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
